51:  * @param {string} name - Handler name.
52:  * @param {Function} [fn] - Set the handler method.
53:  */
54: export function handler (type, name, fn) {
55:   if (arguments.length > 2) {

60: }

66:  * @return {parserFn} The parser method.
67:  */
68: export function parser (name, fn) {

70: }

75:  * @param {formatterFn} [fn] - Set the formatter method.

77:  */

80: }

84:  * @param {string} name - Validator name.
85:  * @param {validatorFn} [fn] - Set the validator method.
86:  * @return {validatorFn} The validator method.
87:  */
88: export function validator (name, fn) {

90: }
91: 
92: /**
93:  * Create a middleware.
94:  * @param {MenquerySchema|Object} [schema] - Schema object.
95:  * @param {Object} [options] - Options to be passed to schema.
96:  * @return {Function} The middleware.
97:  */
98: export function middleware (schema, options) {
99:   return function (req, res, next) {
100:     let _schema = schema instanceof MenquerySchema
101:                 ? _.clone(schema)
102:                 : new MenquerySchema(schema, options)
103: 
104:     _.forIn(handlers, (typedHandler, type) => {
105:       _.forIn(typedHandler, (handler, name) => {
106:         _schema.handler(type, name, handler)
107:       })
108:     })
109: 
110:     _schema.validate(req.query, (err) => {
111:       if (err) {
112:         res.status(400)
113:         return next(err)
114:       }
115: 
116:       req = _.merge(req, _schema.parse())
117:       next()
118:     })
119:   }
120: }

predictions.source_summary: Global handlers (parsers, formatters, validators) registered via exported functions (parser, formatter, validator) are propagated to schema instance during middleware initialization
predictions.sink_summary: User-controlled req.query values flow through schema.validate() and schema.parse() to individual parameter handlers (parsers, formatters, validators) that process parameter values
predictions.guard_summary: Validation occurs via schema.validate() which calls param.validate() on each parameter, but custom handlers can bypass or weaken built-in validation
predictions.risk_pattern: Global handler registration system allows arbitrary code execution via custom parsers/formatters/validators that process user-controlled query parameters without proper sandboxing or validation
predictions.context_summary: The candidate statement propagates globally registered handlers to a schema instance during middleware setup, enabling custom handlers to process user-controlled query parameters
